title: [DEV from 18.12.2020] RileyLink changes causes in many RL connection lost with no reconnect
symptom: With the dev version from 18.12.2020, there are changes done with RileyLink connection. The user experiences many connection lost to their Medtronic RileyLink 2.2, and it does not reconnect automatically; they have to close and restart the Bluetooth connection and/or close and restart AAPS to get the RL to connect again.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. The user initially suspected the changes for Omnipod, but after a phone restart, the issue was resolved, suggesting it may have been a phone state issue.
fix: Restarting the phone after installation fixed the issue. The user reported no connection lost after 23 hours and closed the issue.
evidence_quote: After 23 hours with no problems this issue can be closed. Restart phone has fixed this issue and the version is working good so far.
